findings.description: Component MUST be named LoggerComponent and defined using define_component! macro
ILogger interface MUST be defined in shared interfaces crate using define_interface! with error, warn, info, debug methods
findings.notes: define_interface! { pub ILogger { fn error, fn warn, fn info, fn debug } }

findings.description: Component MUST implement IUnknown for runtime interface discovery of ILogger
findings.notes: Auto-generated by define_component! macro; verified in tests/integration.rs:22-27 via query_interface!

findings.description: Log level filtering MUST be controlled by RUST_LOG environment variable with env_logger semantics
findings.notes: from_env() reads RUST_LOG; from_env_str() handles case-insensitive parsing, trace->Debug, invalid->Info

findings.description: Console output MUST be the default logging destination, writing to stderr
Console output MUST include ANSI color codes to distinguish log levels
Component MUST support alternative file output mode to a specified file path
findings.notes: new_with_file() opens in append mode with create(true)

findings.description: File output MUST NOT contain ANSI color codes
findings.notes: use_color: false set unconditionally for file loggers

findings.description: Every log message MUST include timestamp, log level, and user-provided message text
findings.notes: Format: '{timestamp} {level} {msg}' with ISO 8601 millis via chrono

findings.description: Component MUST be thread-safe (Send + Sync) without message interleaving
findings.notes: Mutex<Box<dyn Write + Send>> ensures atomic writes; integration test verifies 4 threads x 100 msgs

findings.description: When RUST_LOG is not set, logger MUST default to info level
Component MUST provide new_with_writer for custom output targets
findings.notes: Accepts Box<dyn Write + Send>, explicit LogLevel, and use_color flag

findings.description: Console color output MUST be auto-detected via libc::isatty(STDERR_FILENO)
findings.notes: unsafe { libc::isatty(libc::STDERR_FILENO) } != 0; file loggers always set use_color: false

findings.description: LogLevel enum MUST be public with from_env_str and Display; LoggerState is public
findings.notes: pub enum LogLevel (line 36), pub fn from_env_str (line 57), Display impl (line 94), pub struct LoggerState (line 104)
